{{Top|leg}}
'''Aquatic Assault Vehicle''' was the term given to combat-capable [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] craft developed for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Hydrospeare Corporation]]'s [[Explorer Submergible]] was considered to be one of the first Aquatic Assault Vehicles despite being officially labeled as an "exploratory vehicle" due to its potent combat capabilities.
